Priyanka Srinivasan
Talent Acquisition Specialist | Ahmedabad
priyanka.srinivasan524@example.com | +91 9363678126

Resourceful Talent Acquisition Specialist with experience partnering with hiring managers to deliver high-volume and niche hires across engineering and product teams. Strong operational focus driving end-to-end recruiting programs, HRIS administration, and process improvements to reduce time-to-fill. Comfortable working in fast-paced, data-driven environments; notice period: 90 days.

Experience

Meesho — Sep 2023 - Present
Talent Acquisition Specialist (Hybrid)
- Managed full-cycle Talent Acquisition for mid-senior engineering and product roles using LinkedIn Recruiter, sourcing 120+ candidates and progressing 35 to hiring manager interviews; contributed to a 22% reduction in average time-to-fill for key roles.
- Administered HRIS activities in Workday and maintained accurate candidate and employee records, cutting data reconciliation issues by 40% through standardized templates and weekly audits.
- Partnered with hiring managers to design role profiles and interview frameworks, running structured selection panels and increasing offer acceptance rate by 12% through targeted candidate communication and counters.
- Implemented tracking via Git-based dashboards for recruitment sprints and applied Agile principles to standups and backlog prioritization with stakeholders, improving recruiter throughput by 18%.

Pixelwave Studios — Feb 2023 - Aug 2023
HR Executive (On-site)
- Led Recruitment efforts for creative and technical roles, executing outreach and screening using LinkedIn Recruiter and coordinated interview scheduling; supported 60+ candidate interactions and closed 14 hires within six months.
- Supported HRIS data entry and employee onboarding tasks in Workday, streamlining documentation and reducing new-hire processing time by 25%.
- Ran weekly hiring status Agile ceremonies with hiring teams, tracked pipelines, and produced recruitment reports that highlighted bottlenecks and informed process adjustments.
- Assisted with campus hiring and referral programs, tracking outcomes in Git-tracked spreadsheets to measure source effectiveness and improve sourcing mix.

Projects
- Internal Referral Tracker: Built and maintained a Git repository of referral metrics and dashboards to monitor source-to-hire conversion; used weekly Agile check-ins to keep data current and actionable.
- Candidate Experience Audit: Conducted a structured review of touchpoints across Workday and LinkedIn Recruiter workflows, recommended changes that improved candidate communication timelines by 30%.

Skills
Recruitment: Recruitment, Talent Acquisition, LinkedIn Recruiter
HR Systems: Workday, HRIS
Tools & Practices: Git, Linux, Agile

Education
B.Sc Computer Science, St. Xavier's College
